jobleJodohmuTable.title: Joble: a planned meeting for marriage
jobleJodohmuTable.subtitle: A private, intentional meeting for two people who want to explore marriage - with a format that respects both sides.
jobleJodohmuTable.heroLead: Joble means Jodohmu Table: a real-world meeting designed around clarity, comfort, and the serious intention to marry - never endless swiping.
jobleJodohmuTable.flowIntro: The details are agreed with both people before anyone meets.
points: Marriage is the goal. A Joble is not a casual date or a profile-shopping experience.
It is open to everyone. You may choose an imam, priest, the Jodohmu team, or no facilitator.
Human judgment replaces endless swiping, catfishing risk, and conversations with no clear direction.
You can bring trusted people, so the meeting feels grounded rather than lonely or pressured.
steps: Tell us your conversation style, boundaries, and who you would feel comfortable bringing.
Choose one facilitator option: an imam, priest, Jodohmu team member, or no facilitator.
We align both sides. If preferences clash, Jodohmu proposes the final format that is comfortable and respectful for everyone.
We coordinate a private venue, timing, food, and a clear meeting plan before the Joble happens.
After the meeting, each person reflects privately and decides whether the next conversation makes sense.
jobleJodohmuTable.scenario: A Joble is designed to create clarity, not performance. You arrive knowing the purpose, the format, who will be present, and what happens after the conversation.
whatWeHandle: Pearl Joble: one planned meeting with a prepared meal. Each person may bring one trusted guest and choose one facilitator.
Ruby Joble: two planned meetings with buffet dining. Each person may bring up to two trusted guests and choose one facilitator.
Diamond Joble: three private meetings at a 4- or 5-star hotel with buffet dining. Each person may bring up to two trusted guests and one facilitator is included.
The package sets the hospitality level. Jodohmu coordinates the practical details so both people can focus on the conversation.
jobleJodohmuTable.facilitationTitle: One facilitator, if you want one
jobleJodohmuTable.facilitationBody: A facilitator is one person, not a couple. Their role is to help the meeting begin comfortably and stay respectful. The choice is yours, subject to the other person's agreement and availability.
jobleJodohmuTable.pricingTitle: Food and guests are planned, not extras
jobleJodohmuTable.pricingBody: Food is included according to the Joble format. Pearl uses a prepared meal; Ruby uses buffet dining; Diamond uses a 4- or 5-star hotel buffet. Guest limits keep the room balanced and the conversation personal.
